profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Bank of America
profile.summary: I’m a data-driven professional with a strong background in Python, SQL, and automation—specializing in data analysis, natural language processing, and model optimization. Over the past several years, I’ve developed and deployed AI-driven solutions that enhanced model accuracy, streamlined data ingestion, and improved system performance across enterprise environments. My experience spans from designing automation scripts and managing Agile teams to leading analytics initiatives that drive measurable business impact. Passionate about learning and innovation, I thrive at the intersection of technology and problem-solving, always looking for new ways to transform complex data into actionable insights.

positions.title: Assistant Vice President; Software Enginner II
Assistant Vice President; Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Natural Language Processing

• Utilize Snorkel tool to create labeling functions within the platform to classify and/or extract desired information for OCR’d documentations
• Exploit Ignite tool, Python, and Regular Expressions to extract patterns to fine tune models where the accuracy is equal to or greater than the bank’s minimal threshold

Activities 

• TAP Mentor
• Campus Recruiting

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• CPU, memory, and load utilization are managed to keep track of the storage on servers. Alerts are often alarmed due to false-positives. Analyze the trends in data and find normal trends based on previous data
• Python scripts are developed to detect the anomalies and alert personnel of server performance that exceeds thresholds to make their infrastructure efficient

positions.title: NAS Engineer Intern
positions.description: Automated e-mail and text alerting to Infrastructure resources when capacity, performance, and configuration of NAS Infrastructure are at and/or above threshold. A web portal for viewing event logs. Also, developed a python script within a Linux environment to send email alerts if there was a certain percentage storage capacity change. SSL Certificates were generated to configure iLO's to deploy scality object based storage on new x86 servers.

positions.title: Sales Representative
positions.description: Part time job where I sustain and replenish footwear inventory to protect company assets and maximize sales. As well as, providing service to customers by taking cash and credit card payments in exchange for goods while ensuring 100% customer satisfaction.

positions.title: Application Developer Intern
positions.description: The development of a web application to modify a pair of tables on the database system, in which they are used to store and manage runtime variables for switches and feature toggling. The UI developed using HTML, JavaScript, Angular JS, and Union Pacific's framework, Ricola. The back-end developed using  Spring, Java, SQL, and UP’s XMF infrastructure. As well as JUnit testing.

educations.schoolName: North Carolina Agricultural and Technical State University

projects.title: SHARE Conference Master the Mainframe Hackathon
projects.description: Attended SHARE Mainframe conference in Providence, Rhode Island. Participated in the Master the Mainframe Hackathon. Participants got a first view at the 2017 IBM Master the Mainframe Contest content while participating in the hackathon. The goal was to see who could accomplish the most criteria accurately within the limited timeframe.

projects.title: UP's Hackathon
projects.description: One of the most important railroad performance metrics at UP is "carloading", or the amount of freight loaded into cars during some specified duration of time. UP's daily and 7-day total carloading numbers are displayed on the UPRR employee homepage. Our goal was to develop model that predicts these numbers given two data sets.
